title_en: Preference Goal Tuning: Post-Training as Latent Control for Frozen Policies
title_zh: 偏好目标调优：面向冻结策略的后训练作为潜在控制

sentences.en: Goal-conditioned policies enable decision-making models to execute diverse behaviors based on specified goals, yet their downstream performance is often highly sensitive to the choice of instructions or prompts.
sentences.zh: 目标条件策略使决策模型能够基于指定目标执行多样的行为，然而它们的下游表现往往对指令或提示的选择高度敏感。

sentences.en: To bypass the limitations of discrete text prompts, we formulate post-training adaptation as a latent control problem, where the goal embedding serves as a continuous control variable to modulate the behavior of a frozen policy.
sentences.zh: 为绕过离散文本提示的局限，我们将后训练适应表述为一个潜在控制问题，其中目标嵌入充当调节冻结策略行为的连续控制变量。

sentences.en: We propose Preference Goal Tuning (PGT), a framework that optimizes this latent control variable to align the induced trajectory distribution with task preferences.
sentences.zh: 我们提出偏好目标调优（PGT），一个优化这种潜在控制变量以使诱导的轨迹分布与任务偏好对齐的框架。

sentences.en: Unlike standard fine-tuning that updates policy parameters, PGT keeps the policy frozen and updates only the latent goal using a trajectory-level preference objective.
sentences.zh: 与更新策略参数的标准微调不同，PGT保持策略冻结，仅使用轨迹级偏好目标更新潜在目标。

sentences.en: This approach essentially searches for the optimal conditioning input that maximizes the likelihood of preferred behaviors while suppressing undesirable ones.
sentences.zh: 这一方法本质上是搜索最大化偏好行为似然同时抑制不良行为的最优条件输入。

sentences.en: We evaluate PGT on the Minecraft SkillForge benchmark across 17 tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们在Minecraft SkillForge基准上跨17个任务评估PGT。

sentences.en: With minimal data, PGT achieves average relative improvements of 72.0\% and 81.6\% on two foundation policies, consistently outperforming expert-crafted prompts.
sentences.zh: 在极少量数据下，PGT在两个基础策略上取得72.0\%与81.6\%的平均相对改进，持续优于专家设计的提示。

sentences.en: Crucially, by decoupling task alignment (latent goal) from physical dynamics (frozen policy), PGT surpasses full fine-tuning by 13.4\% in out-of-distribution settings, demonstrating superior robustness and generalization.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，通过将任务对齐（潜在目标）与物理动力学（冻结策略）解耦，PGT在分布外设定中超过完全微调13.4\%，展现出卓越的鲁棒性与泛化能力。

title_en: Preference-based Antibody Expression Ranking: Scaling with Large-scale Weak Supervision
title_zh: 基于偏好的抗体表达排名：用大规模弱监督扩展

sentences.en: Antibody expression ranking is a critical task in antibody design, yet its modelling is severely hindered by the scarcity of labeled experimental data.
sentences.zh: 抗体表达排名是抗体设计中的关键任务，然而对其建模受到标注实验数据稀缺的严重阻碍。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose a unified preference-based learning framework that integrates scarce quantitative expression data with large-scale weak positive supervision from immunization data.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出一个统一的基于偏好的学习框架，将稀缺的定量表达数据与来自免疫数据的大规模弱正监督整合起来。

sentences.en: We adapt Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to protein language models by introducing a union-masked log-likelihood approximation and IMGT-based alignment, enabling efficient training on variable-length sequences.
sentences.zh: 我们通过引入联合掩码对数似然近似与基于IMGT的对齐，将直接偏好优化（DPO）适配到蛋白质语言模型，从而能够在变长序列上进行高效训练。

sentences.en: Evaluating on a diverse internal dataset of 1254 labeled sequences and 4 million unlabeled camelid-derived antibodies, we show that our method consistently outperforms baselines on most metrics.
sentences.zh: 在一个包含1254条标注序列与4百万条未标注骆驼科来源抗体的多样内部数据集上评估，我们表明我们的方法在大多数指标上持续优于基线。

sentences.en: Our results demonstrate that preference learning can effectively learn from weak supervision, providing a scalable solution for antibody expressibility optimization in data-constrained settings.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，偏好学习能够有效地从弱监督中学习，为数据受限设定中的抗体可表达性优化提供一个可扩展的解决方案。

sentences.en: Project page: https://kisoji-biotechnology-inc.github.io/Preference-Expression-Ranking/.
sentences.zh: 项目页面：https://kisoji-biotechnology-inc.github.io/Preference-Expression-Ranking/。

title_en: Preference-Calibrated Optimization with Score-Level Distribution Alignment for Text-to-Image Diffusion Model Unlearning
title_zh: 面向文生图扩散模型遗忘的偏好校准优化与分数级分布对齐

sentences.en: While text-to-image diffusion models achieve remarkable generation quality, they inadvertently memorize sensitive content, necessitating machine unlearning to prevent undesired outputs.
sentences.zh: 虽然文生图扩散模型取得了出色的生成质量，但它们无意中记忆敏感内容，需要机器遗忘来防止不良输出。

sentences.en: However, existing unlearning methods rely on suboptimal surrogate objectives rather than directly optimizing the unlearning goal, leading to fundamental objective mismatch.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有遗忘方法依赖次优的代理目标而非直接优化遗忘目标，导致根本的目标错配。

sentences.en: Moreover, these methods preserve model utility via surface-level constraints on model parameters or outputs, yet fail to capture the intrinsic generative dynamics of diffusion models, consequently triggering catastrophic forgetting.
sentences.zh: 此外，这些方法通过对模型参数或输出的表面层面约束来保持模型效用，却未能捕捉扩散模型内在的生成动力学，从而引发灾难性遗忘。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose Preference-calibrated Optimization with Score-level Distribution Alignment (POSDA), a unified unlearning framework that harmonizes effective erasure with fine-grained structural preservation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出偏好校准优化与分数级分布对齐（POSDA），一个统一的无悔遗忘框架，协调有效擦除与细粒度结构保留。

sentences.en: Specifically, we reframe unlearning as a preference optimization problem by constructing a reward that explicitly quantifies the unlearning objective.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们通过构造一个显式量化遗忘目标的奖励来将遗忘重构为偏好优化问题。

sentences.en: Additionally, we introduce score-level distribution alignment to ensure the invariance of the underlying manifold topology of the unlearned model, thereby preventing distributional drift.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入分数级分布对齐，以确保被遗忘模型底层流形拓扑的不变性，从而防止分布漂移。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across object, style, and NSFW unlearning tasks demonstrate that POSDA achieves state-of-the-art erasure efficacy while maintaining superior model utility compared to existing methods.
sentences.zh: 跨物体、风格与NSFW遗忘任务的大量实验表明，与现有方法相比，POSDA实现了最先进的擦除效果，同时保持卓越的模型效用。

title_en: Preference-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for Pluralistic Image Inpainting
title_zh: 面向多元图像修复的偏好增强强化学习

sentences.en: Existing image inpainting frameworks rely on strictly supervised training paradigms, often suffering from an over-reliance on ground-truth reconstruction, which leads to conservative outputs with misaligned creativity and limited diversity.
sentences.zh: 现有图像修复框架依赖严格监督的训练范式，往往过度依赖地面真值重建，导致保守输出伴随错位的创造力与有限的多样性。

sentences.en: To this end, we propose the first framework to explore Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) for text-guided image inpainting, formulating an efficient online reinforcement learning pipeline that enables flexible, human-aligned aesthetic control via a preference scoring model.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出第一个探索组相对策略优化（GRPO）与直接偏好优化（DPO）用于文本引导图像修复的框架，形成一个高效的在线强化学习流程，通过偏好评分模型实现灵活、与人对齐的美学控制。

sentences.en: Crucially, by decoupling the rigid one-to-one correspondence between text prompts and masked images, our method enables the model to explore diverse, controllable, and high-quality solutions beyond a single target.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，通过解耦文本提示与掩码图像之间僵化的一一对应，我们的方法使模型能够在单一目标之外探索多样、可控且高质量的解决方案。

sentences.en: Furthermore, to balance semantic consistency with physical naturalness at mask boundaries, we introduce a scale-aware dynamic reward mechanism that adaptively emphasizes boundary gradient coherence for small occlusions while prioritizing visual aesthetics in large-scale generation.
sentences.zh: 此外，为平衡掩码边界处的语义一致性与物理自然性，我们引入一个尺度感知的动态奖励机制，对小的遮挡自适应地强调边界梯度一致性，而在大规模生成中优先考虑视觉美学。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach consistently produces higher-quality results across different backbone architectures such as Stable Diffusion and FLUX, significantly enhancing the generative capacity of base models.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法在Stable Diffusion与FLUX等不同骨干架构上持续产生更高质量的结果，显著增强基础模型的生成能力。

title_en: Preference-Modulated Structural Attention for Multi-Objective Combinatorial Optimization
title_zh: 面向多目标组合优化的偏好调制结构注意力

sentences.en: Recent decomposition-based approaches have achieved significant success in Multi-Objective Combinatorial Optimization (MOCO).
sentences.zh: 近期基于分解的方法在多目标组合优化（MOCO）中取得了显著成功。

sentences.en: However,existing methods typically rely exclusively on node-centric representations, failing to capture the complementary representations provided by edge features for problem instances, resulting in a persistent optimality gap.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法通常只依赖以节点为中心的表示，未能捕捉边特征为问题实例提供的互补表示，导致持续存在的最优性差距。

sentences.en: To address this , we propose a Preference-Modulated Structural Attention mechanism to enhance problem representation by synergizing node and edge features.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出一个偏好调制结构注意力机制，通过协同节点与边特征增强问题表示。

sentences.en: It includes: (1) Utilizing preference-modulated edge features as explicit structural biases during attention calculation, enabling model to perceive sub-problem structures conditioned on specific preferences,and (2) an edge feature aggregation strategy that dynamically incorporates node-specific context into edge representations to enhance the perception of preference-aware structures.
sentences.zh: 它包括：（1）在注意力计算期间利用偏好调制的边特征作为显式结构偏差，使模型能够感知以特定偏好为条件的子问题结构，以及（2）一个边特征聚合策略，将节点特定的上下文动态纳入边表示，以增强对偏好感知结构的感知。

sentences.en: Experiments on classic MOCOP benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our approach in terms of both performance and generalization capabilities.
sentences.zh: 在经典MOCOP基准上的实验证明了我们的方法在性能与泛化能力两方面都具备优越性。

title_en: Prefix-Cache-Aware Data Reordering for LLM-Augmented Database Analytics
title_zh: 面向LLM增强数据库分析的前缀缓存感知数据重排

sentences.en: LLM-augmented database analytics face a major bottleneck in the costly prefill phase.
sentences.zh: LLM增强的数据库分析在代价高昂的预填充阶段面临一个主要瓶颈。

sentences.en: Although relational tables inherently contain repeated attribute values, standard row-by-row processing produces fragmented prompt layouts that obscure shared prefixes, thereby minimizing opportunities for prefix KV cache reuse and constraining system efficiency.
sentences.zh: 尽管关系表天然包含重复的属性值，标准的逐行处理产生支离破碎的提示布局，掩盖共享前缀，从而最小化前缀KV缓存复用的机会并制约系统效率。

sentences.en: Existing solutions typically employ heuristic or exhaustive search methods to reorder prompt layouts, but these approaches can be inefficient and may not leverage the structural properties of relational tables.
sentences.zh: 现有解决方案通常采用启发式或穷举搜索方法重排提示布局，但这些方法可能低效，且未必利用关系表的结构性质。

sentences.en: We address this challenge by formulating prefix-cache-aware prompt layout optimization as a problem rooted in the isomorphism between prefix-cache reuse and the radix tree topology induced by the relational data distribution.
sentences.zh: 我们通过将前缀缓存感知的提示布局优化表述为一个根植于前缀缓存复用与关系数据分布诱导的基数树拓扑之间同构的问题来应对这一挑战。

sentences.en: Building on this perspective, we introduce a practical greedy tree-shaping algorithm that efficiently selects row and column orderings to maximize prefix overlap.
sentences.zh: 基于这一视角，我们引入一个实用的贪心树塑形算法，高效选择行与列排序以最大化前缀重叠。

sentences.en: Our approach, SOLO, improves prefill throughput by up to 90.3\% under fixed prefix-cache budget.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法SOLO在固定前缀缓存预算下将预填充吞吐量提高多达90.3\%。

sentences.en: Moreover, it reduces planning overhead by up to 242$\times$ compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
sentences.zh: 此外，与最先进基线相比，它将规划开销减少多达242$\times$倍。

authors.institution: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

title_en: Prescriptive Scaling Reveals the Evolution of Language Model Capabilities
title_zh: 规范性扩展揭示语言模型能力的演化

sentences.en: For deploying foundation models, practitioners increasingly need prescriptive scaling laws: given a pre-training compute budget, what downstream accuracy is attainable with contemporary post-training practice, and how stable is that mapping as the field evolves?
sentences.zh: 对于部署基础模型，从业者日益需要规范性扩展定律：给定一个预训练计算预算，当代后训练实践可达到哪些下游准确性，且随着领域演化，这一映射有多稳定？

sentences.en: Using large-scale observational evaluations with 5k observational and 2k newly sampled data on model performance, we estimate capability boundaries—high conditional quantiles of benchmark scores as a function of log pre-training FLOPs, via smoothed quantile regression with a monotone, saturating sigmoid parameterization.
sentences.zh: 利用对模型性能的大规模观测评估（5k个观测与2k个新采样的数据），我们通过带单调饱和sigmoid参数化的平滑分位数回归，估计能力边界——基准分数作为对数预训练FLOPs函数的高条件分位数。

sentences.en: We validate the temporal reliability by fitting on earlier model generations and evaluating on later releases.
sentences.zh: 我们通过在更早的模型代上拟合并对后来的发布进行评估来验证时间可靠性。

sentences.en: Across various tasks, the estimated boundaries are mostly stable, with the exception of math reasoning that exhibits a consistently advancing boundary over time.
sentences.zh: 跨各种任务，估计的边界大都稳定，唯一的例外是数学推理，它表现出随时间持续推进的边界。

sentences.en: We then extend our approach to analyze task-dependent saturation and to probe contamination-related shifts on math reasoning tasks.
sentences.zh: 随后我们扩展我们的方法，以分析任务相关的饱和，并探测数学推理任务上与污染相关的偏移。

sentences.en: Finally, we introduce an efficient algorithm that recovers near-full-data frontiers using roughly 20% of evaluation budget.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们引入一个高效算法，用大约20%的评估预算恢复接近全数据的边界。

sentences.en: Together, our work releases the Proteus-2k, the latest model performance evaluation dataset, and introduces a practical methodology for translating compute budgets into reliable performance expectations and for monitoring when capability boundaries move.
sentences.zh: 综合来看，我们的工作发布Proteus-2k（最新的模型性能评估数据集），并引入一个将计算预算转化为可靠性能期望以及监控能力边界何时移动的实用方法论。

title_en: Preserve-Then-Quantize: Balancing Rank Budgets for Quantization Error Reconstruction in LLMs
title_zh: 先保留再量化：平衡LLM量化误差重构的秩预算

sentences.en: Quantization Error Reconstruction (QER) reduces accuracy loss in Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) by approximating weights as $\mathbf{W} \approx \mathbf{Q} + \mathbf{L}\mathbf{R}$, using a rank-$r$ correction to reconstruct quantization error.
sentences.zh: 量化误差重构（QER）通过将权重近似为 $\mathbf{W} \approx \mathbf{Q} + \mathbf{L}\mathbf{R}$（使用秩-$r$校正重构量化误差）来减少训练后量化（PTQ）中的准确率损失。

sentences.en: Prior methods devote the full rank budget to error reconstruction, which is suboptimal when $\mathbf{W}$ has intrinsic low-rank structure and quantization corrupts dominant directions.
sentences.zh: 先前的方法将全部秩预算用于误差重构，当 $\mathbf{W}$ 具有内在低秩结构且量化破坏主导方向时，这是次优的。

sentences.en: We propose Structured Residual Reconstruction (SRR), a rank-allocation framework that preserves the top-$k$ singular subspace of the activation-scaled weight before quantization, quantizes only the residual, and uses the remaining rank $r-k$ for error reconstruction.
sentences.zh: 我们提出结构化残差重构（SRR），一个秩分配框架，在量化之前保留激活缩放权重的顶-$k$奇异子空间，仅量化残差，并用剩余的秩 $r-k$ 进行误差重构。

sentences.en: We derive a theory-guided criterion for selecting $k$ by balancing quantization-exposed energy  and unrecoverable error under rank constraints.
sentences.zh: 我们通过平衡秩约束下量化暴露的能量与不可恢复的误差，推导出一个理论引导的 $k$ 选择准则。

sentences.en: We further show that resulting $\mathbf{Q}+\mathbf{L}\mathbf{R}$ parameterization naturally supports Quantized Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (QPEFT), and stabilizes fine-tuning via gradient scaling along preserved directions.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步表明，所得的 $\mathbf{Q}+\mathbf{L}\mathbf{R}$ 参数化自然支持量化参数高效微调（QPEFT），并通过沿保留方向的梯度缩放稳定微调。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate consistent perplexity reductions across diverse models and quantization settings in PTQ, along with a 5.9 percentage-point average gain on GLUE under 2-bit QPEFT.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，在PTQ中跨多样模型与量化设定带来一致的困惑度降低，以及在2比特QPEFT下GLUE上5.9个百分点的平均增益。

sentences.en: The project page is available at https://ai-isl.github.io/srr.
sentences.zh: 项目页面可在 https://ai-isl.github.io/srr 获取。

title_en: Preserving Expert-Level Privacy in Offline Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 在离线强化学习中保持专家级隐私

sentences.en: The offline reinforcement learning (RL) problem aims to learn an optimal policy from historical data collected by one or more behavioural policies (experts) by interacting with an environment.
sentences.zh: 离线强化学习（RL）问题旨在从由一个或多个行为策略（专家）通过与环境交互收集的历史数据中学习最优策略。

sentences.en: However, the individual experts may be privacy-sensitive in that the learnt policy may retain information about their precise choices.
sentences.zh: 然而，个体专家可能是隐私敏感的，因为习得的策略可能保留关于他们精确选择的信息。

sentences.en: In some domains like personalized retrieval, advertising and healthcare, the expert choices are considered sensitive data.
sentences.zh: 在个性化检索、广告与医疗等一些领域，专家选择被视为敏感数据。

sentences.en: To provably protect the privacy of such experts, we propose a novel consensus-based expert-level differentially private offline RL training approach compatible with any existing offline RL algorithm.
sentences.zh: 为以可证明的方式保护此类专家的隐私，我们提出一种新颖的基于共识的专家级差分隐私离线RL训练方法，它与任何现有离线RL算法兼容。

sentences.en: We prove rigorous differential privacy guarantees, while maintaining strong empirical performance.
sentences.zh: 我们证明严谨的差分隐私保证，同时维持强劲的实证表现。

sentences.en: Unlike existing work in differentially private RL, we supplement the theory with proof-of-concept experiments on classic RL environments featuring large continuous state spaces, demonstrating substantial improvements over a natural baseline across multiple tasks.
sentences.zh: 与差分隐私RL中的现有工作不同，我们用经典RL环境（包含大型连续状态空间）上的概念验证实验补充理论，展示在多个任务上相对于自然基线的显著改进。

title_en: Preserving Plasticity in Continual Learning via Dynamical Isometry
title_zh: 通过动力学等距保持持续学习中的可塑性

sentences.en: Continual training of deep neural networks under non-stationarity often leads to a progressive loss of plasticity, eventually limiting further learning.
sentences.zh: 非平稳性下深度神经网络的持续训练往往导致可塑性的渐进丧失，最终限制进一步学习。

sentences.en: We relate plasticity to the empirical Neural Tangent Kernel, and identify dynamical isometry (the condition that layer-wise Jacobian singular values remain close to one) as a key mechanism for preserving plasticity in continual learning.
sentences.zh: 我们将可塑性与经验性神经正切核相关联，并识别出动力学等距（逐层Jacobian奇异值保持接近一的条件）作为在持续学习中保持可塑性的关键机制。

sentences.en: We revisit a class of networks that are almost-everywhere isometric while remaining universal Lipschitz function approximators, demonstrating that near-dynamical isometry is compatible with expressive nonlinear representations.
sentences.zh: 我们重新审视一类近乎处处等距同时保持通用Lipschitz函数逼近能力的网络，证明近动力学等距与表达性非线性表示相容。

sentences.en: For general architectures, we propose an efficient isometry-promoting regularization scheme and identify a novel mechanism by which it can reactivate dormant ReLU units.
sentences.zh: 对于一般架构，我们提出一个高效的促进等距的正则化方案，并识别出它能够重新激活休眠ReLU单元的一个新机制。

sentences.en: Building on this, we introduce AdamO, an Adam-style adaptive optimizer that decouples isometry regularization from gradient updates, analogous to AdamW. We further reinterpret prior plasticity-preserving approaches through the lens of dynamical isometry, showing that they target only a partial measure of isometry.
sentences.zh: 基于此，我们引入AdamO，一个Adam风格的自适应优化器，它将等距正则化与梯度更新解耦，类似于AdamW。我们进一步通过动力学等距的视角重新解读先前的可塑性保持方法，表明它们只针对等距的部分度量。

sentences.en: Across supervised and reinforcement-learning continual-learning benchmarks designed to induce plasticity loss, our methods consistently match or outperform existing approaches.
sentences.zh: 跨设计用于诱发可塑性丧失的有监督与强化学习持续学习基准，我们的方法持续匹配或优于现有方法。

title_en: Pressure Reveals Character: Behavioural Alignment Evaluation at Depth
title_zh: 压力揭示本性：有深度的行为对齐评估

sentences.en: Evaluating alignment in language models requires testing how they behave under realistic pressure, not just what they claim they would do.
sentences.zh: 评估语言模型中的对齐需要测试它们在现实压力下如何表现，而不仅仅是它们声称会做什么。

sentences.en: While alignment failures increasingly cause real-world harm, comprehensive evaluation frameworks with realistic multi-turn scenarios remain lacking.
sentences.zh: 虽然对齐失败日益造成现实世界的伤害，但具有现实主义多轮场景的全面评估框架仍然缺乏。

sentences.en: We introduce an alignment benchmark spanning 904 scenarios across six categories---Honesty, Safety, Non-Manipulation, Robustness, Corrigibility, and Scheming---validated as realistic by human raters.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个跨越六个类别——诚实、安全、非操纵、鲁棒性、可矫正性与密谋——904个场景的对齐基准，并由人类评分者验证为现实。

sentences.en: Our scenarios place models under conflicting instructions, simulated tool access, and multi-turn escalation to reveal behavioral tendencies that single-turn evaluations miss.
sentences.zh: 我们的场景使模型处于冲突指令、模拟工具访问与多轮升级之下，以揭示单轮评估会遗漏的行为倾向。

sentences.en: Evaluating 24 frontier models using LLM judges validated against human annotations, we find that even top-performing models exhibit gaps in specific categories, while the majority of models show consistent weaknesses across the board.
sentences.zh: 使用经人类标注验证的LLM评判器评估24个前沿模型，我们发现即使是表现最好的模型也在特定类别上展现差距，而大多数模型在各方面表现出持续弱点。

sentences.en: Factor analysis reveals that alignment behaves as a unified construct (analogous to the g-factor in cognitive research) with models scoring high on one category tending to score high on others.
sentences.zh: 因子分析揭示，对齐行为像一个统一构念（类似于认知研究中的g因子），在一个类别得分高的模型往往在其他类别得分也高。

sentences.en: We publicly release the benchmark and an interactive leaderboard to support ongoing evaluation, with plans to expand scenarios in areas where we observe persistent weaknesses and to add new models as they are released.
sentences.zh: 我们公开发布该基准与一个交互式排行榜以支持持续评估，并计划在我们的观察中持续弱点的领域扩展场景，以及在新模型发布时添加它们。

title_en: Pretrained Vision-Language-Action Models are Surprisingly Resistant to Forgetting in Continual Learning
title_zh: 预训练的视觉-语言-动作模型在持续学习中出人意料地抵抗遗忘

sentences.en: Continual learning is a long-standing challenge in robot policy learning, where a policy must acquire new skills over time without catastrophically forgetting previously learned ones.
sentences.zh: 持续学习是机器人策略学习中的一个长期挑战，其中策略必须随时间获得新技能，而不灾难性地遗忘先前习得的技能。

sentences.en: While prior work has extensively studied continual learning in relatively small behavior cloning (BC) policy models trained from scratch, its behavior in modern large-scale pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remains underexplored.
sentences.zh: 虽然先前工作广泛研究了相对较小的从零训练行为克隆（BC）策略模型中的持续学习，但它在现代大规模预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的行为仍未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: In this work, we find that pretrained VLAs are remarkably resistant to forgetting compared with smaller policy models trained from scratch.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们发现预训练的VLA与从零训练的较小策略模型相比，具有显著的遗忘抵抗力。

sentences.en: Simple Experience Replay (ER) works surprisingly well on VLAs, sometimes achieving zero forgetting even with a small replay data size.
sentences.zh: 简单的经验回放（ER）在VLA上效果出奇地好，有时即使回放数据量很小也能实现零遗忘。

sentences.en: Our analysis reveals that pretraining plays a critical role in downstream continual learning performance: large pretrained models mitigate forgetting with a small replay buffer size while maintaining strong forward learning capabilities.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析揭示，预训练在下游持续学习表现中起着关键作用：大型预训练模型用小回放缓冲区大小缓解遗忘，同时保持强劲的前向学习能力。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we find that VLAs can retain relevant knowledge from prior tasks despite performance degradation during learning new tasks.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们发现VLA尽管在学习新任务时性能退化，但仍能保留先前任务的相关知识。

sentences.en: This knowledge retention enables rapid recovery of seemingly forgotten skills through finetuning.
sentences.zh: 这种知识保留使看似被遗忘的技能能够通过微调快速恢复。

sentences.en: Together, these insights imply that large-scale pretraining fundamentally changes the dynamics of continual learning, enabling models to continually acquire new skills over time with simple replay.
sentences.zh: 综合来看，这些洞见意味着大规模预训练从根本上改变了持续学习的动态，使模型能够用简单回放随时间持续获得新技能。

title_en: PretrainZero: Reinforcement Active Learning on Pretraining Data
title_zh: PretrainZero：在预训练数据上进行强化主动学习

sentences.en: Recent reinforcement learning (RL) based large-thinking models demonstrate impressive expert-level abilities, i.e., software and math, but still rely heavily on verifiable rewards in specific domains, which places a significant bottleneck to extend the performance boundary of general reasoning capabilities.
sentences.zh: 近期基于强化学习（RL）的大思考模型展现出令人印象深刻的专家级能力（即软件与数学），但仍严重依赖特定领域中的可验证奖励，这对扩展通用推理能力的性能边界构成了显著瓶颈。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose PretrainZero, a reinforcement active learning framework built on the pretraining corpus to extend RL from domain-specific post-training to general pretraining.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出PretrainZero，一个建立在预训练语料上的强化主动学习框架，将RL从领域特定的后训练扩展到通用预训练。

sentences.en: PretrainZero features the following characteristics: 1) Active pretraining objectives: inspired by the active learning ability of humans, PretrainZero learns a unified reasoning policy to actively identify reasonable and informative contents from pretraining corpus, and reason to predict these contents by RL.
sentences.zh: PretrainZero具有以下特征：1）主动预训练目标：受人类主动学习能力启发，PretrainZero学习一个统一的推理策略，主动从预训练语料中识别合理且信息丰富的内容，并通过RL推理预测这些内容。

sentences.en: 2) Self-supervised learning: without any verifiable labels, pretrained reward models, or supervised fine-tuning, we directly pretrain reasoners from $3\sim30$B base models on the general Wikipedia corpus using RL, significantly breaking the verification data-wall for general reasoning.
sentences.zh: 2）自监督学习：在没有任何可验证标签、预训练奖励模型或有监督微调的情况下，我们直接用RL在通用Wikipedia语料上从 $3\sim30$B 基础模型预训练推理器，显著突破通用推理的验证数据墙。

sentences.en: 3) Verification scaling: by tackling increasingly challenging masked spans, PretrainZero substantially enhances the general reasoning abilities of pretrained base models.
sentences.zh: 3）验证扩展：通过应对日益具有挑战性的掩码跨度，PretrainZero大幅增强预训练基础模型的通用推理能力。

sentences.en: With reinforcement learning on pretraining data, PretrainZero improves Qwen3-4B-Base for 8.43, 5.96 and 10.60 on MMLU-Pro, SuperGPQA and math average benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 在预训练数据上使用强化学习，PretrainZero在MMLU-Pro、SuperGPQA与数学平均基准上分别将Qwen3-4B-Base提升8.43、5.96与10.60。

sentences.en: In post-training, the pretrained models can also serve as reasoning foundation models for downstream RLVR tasks.
sentences.zh: 在后训练中，预训练模型还可以充当下游RLVR任务的推理基础模型。

title_en: Primal-Spectral Generative Modeling: Fast Analytical Generation via Pseudoinverse Lévy Inversion
title_zh: 原始-谱生成建模：通过伪逆Lévy反演实现快速解析生成

sentences.en: A probability distribution $\mathbb{P}$ is a measure on a $\sigma$-algebra, assigning mass to sets rather than points, which poses a challenge for the training of neural networks that often struggle to reconstruct the global topology of continuous manifolds from sparse samples.
sentences.zh: 概率分布 $\mathbb{P}$ 是 $\sigma$-代数上的测度，将质量赋予集合而非点，这给神经网络的训练带来挑战，因为网络往往难以从稀疏样本重建连续流形的全局拓扑。

sentences.en: We mitigate this issue by transforming $\mathbb{P}$ into a continuous function via spectral methods, providing theoretical guarantees for the convergence of the learned distribution to the true distribution.
sentences.zh: 我们通过谱方法将 $\mathbb{P}$ 变换为连续函数来缓解这一问题，并为学习到的分布收敛到真实分布提供理论保证。

sentences.en: Specifically, we introduce a network, PriSpecNet, with a single-function evaluation (1-NFE) Pseudoinverse L\'evy Inversion (PiLI) solver that regards generation as a fast analytical problem, eliminating the need for iterative numerical integration while maintaining full compatibility with the stochastic interpolants.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们引入PriSpecNet网络，配有一个单函数求值（1-NFE）伪逆Lévy反演（PiLI）求解器，它将生成视为快速解析问题，无需迭代数值积分，同时与随机插值完全兼容。

sentences.en: We test our PriSpecNet in two applications: for time series, it unifies generation and forecasting, outperforming state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines with Context-FID reductions of 50.0\%, 41.5\%, 80.6\%, and 63.1\% on Sines, Solar, ETTh, and Stock benchmarks, respectively, also decreasing forecasting MSE by 29.8\% on Solar and 23.8\% on Stock.
sentences.zh: 我们在两个应用中测试PriSpecNet：对于时间序列，它统一了生成与预测，在Sines、Solar、ETTh与Stock基准上分别以50.0\%、41.5\%、80.6\%与63.1\%的Context-FID降低优于最先进（SOTA）基线，同时将在Solar上的预测MSE降低29.8\%、在Stock上降低23.8\%。

sentences.en: For ImageNet $256 \times 256$, 1-NFE PiLI achieves a competitive FID of **1.66** using only **26** Gflops, representing a **170$\times$** reduction in total Gflops compared to the 4,436 Gflops required by the 25-NFE DPM-Solver++.
sentences.zh: 对于ImageNet $256 \times 256$，1-NFE PiLI仅用 **26** Gflops实现有竞争力的**1.66** FID，与25-NFE DPM-Solver++所需的4,436 Gflops相比，总Gflops减少**170$\times$**。

title_en: PRIM：Cooperative Dynamic Token Compression for Efficient Large Multimodal Models
title_zh: PRIM：面向高效大型多模态模型的协作式动态词元压缩

sentences.en: Large multimodal models (LMMs) have shown strong capabilities in audio-visual understanding by jointly reasoning over visual, auditory, and linguistic inputs.
sentences.zh: 大型多模态模型（LMM）通过联合推理视觉、听觉与语言输入，在音视频理解方面展现了强大能力。

sentences.en: However, processing long-form audio-visual content often requires a large number of tokens, leading to substantial computational and memory overhead during inference.
sentences.zh: 然而，处理长形式的音视频内容往往需要大量词元，导致推理期间可观的计算与内存开销。

sentences.en: Existing efficiency-oriented methods typically apply uniform compression or pruning strategies, which overlook modality-specific characteristics and instruction-dependent reasoning behaviors in multimodal models.
sentences.zh: 现有的效率导向方法通常应用统一的压缩或剪枝策略，忽视了多模态模型中模态特定的特征与指令依赖的推理行为。

sentences.en: In this work, we present PRIM, an inference framework for efficient multimodal reasoning that systematically compresses audio-visual representations based on attention dynamics and instruction relevance.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们呈献PRIM，一个用于高效多模态推理的推理框架，它基于注意力动力学与指令相关性系统性地压缩音视频表示。

sentences.en: Motivated by an attention-based analysis revealing modality imbalance and layer-wise redundancy in LMMs, PRIM introduces a cooperative compression pipeline that spans both multimodal encoders and the language model.
sentences.zh: 受揭示LMM中模态不平衡与逐层冗余的基于注意力的分析所驱动，PRIM引入一个横跨多模态编码器与语言模型的协作压缩流程。

sentences.en: Specifically, PRIM performs early text-conditioned audio-visual fusion to externalize cross-modal interactions, applies attention-guided and frequency-aware strategies to remove redundant audio and video tokens, and further adapts token retention inside the language model according to task demands.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，PRIM执行早期的文本条件音视频融合以外部化跨模态交互，应用注意力引导与频率感知的策略移除冗余的音频与视频词元，并根据任务需求在语言模型内部进一步调整词元保留。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on multiple audio-visual benchmark datasets demonstrate that PRIM consistently achieves stable and superior efficiency--accuracy trade-offs across diverse tasks and datasets.
sentences.zh: 在多个音视频基准数据集上的大量实验表明，PRIM在多样任务与数据集上持续取得稳定且优越的效率-准确率权衡。

sentences.en: These results demonstrate that PRIM, a multimodal cooperative compression approach, provides an effective pathway toward scalable and efficient audio-visual reasoning.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，PRIM作为一种多模态协作压缩方法，为可扩展且高效的音视频推理提供了有效途径。

title_en: Principle-Evolvable Scientific Discovery via Uncertainty Minimization
title_zh: 经由不确定性最小化的可演化原理科学发现

sentences.en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based scientific agents have accelerated scientific discovery, yet they often suffer from significant inefficiencies due to adherence to fixed initial priors.
sentences.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的科学智能体加速了科学发现，但由于对固定初始先验的坚守，它们往往遭受显著的效率低下。

sentences.en: Existing approaches predominantly operate within a static hypothesis space, which restricts the discovery of novel phenomena, resulting in computational waste when baseline theories fail.
sentences.zh: 现有方法主要在静态假设空间中运作，这限制了新现象的发现，并在基线理论失败时导致计算浪费。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose shifting the focus from searching hypotheses to evolving the underlying scientific principles.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出将焦点从搜索假设转向演化底层的科学原理。

sentences.en: We present $\textbf{PiEvo}$, a principle-evolvable framework that treats scientific discovery as Bayesian optimization over an expanding principle space.
sentences.zh: 我们呈献$\textbf{PiEvo}$，一个将科学发现视为在扩展原理空间上的贝叶斯优化的可演化原理框架。

sentences.en: By integrating Information-Directed Hypothesis Selection via Gaussian Process and an anomaly-driven augmentation mechanism, PiEvo enables agents to autonomously refine their theoretical worldview.
sentences.zh: 通过整合经由高斯过程的信息导向假设选择与异常驱动增强机制，PiEvo使智能体能够自主精化其理论世界观。

sentences.en: Evaluation across four benchmarks demonstrates that PiEvo (1) achieves an average solution quality of up to 90.81\%$\sim$93.15\%, representing a 29.7\%$\sim$31.1\% improvement over the state-of-the-art, (2) attains an 83.3\% speedup in convergence step via significantly reduced sample complexity by optimizing the compact principle space, and (3) maintains robust performance across diverse scientific domains and LLM backbones.
sentences.zh: 跨四个基准的评估表明，PiEvo（1）实现高达90.81\%$\sim$93.15\%的平均解质量，代表相对于最先进方法29.7\%$\sim$31.1\%的改进，（2）通过优化紧凑原理空间显著降低样本复杂度，在收敛步上取得83.3\%的加速，以及（3）在多样科学领域与LLM骨干上维持稳健表现。

sentences.en: Code is publicly available at github.com/amair-lab/PiEvo.
sentences.zh: 代码公开可在 github.com/amair-lab/PiEvo 获取。

title_en: Principled Confidence Estimation for Deep Computed Tomography
title_zh: 深度计算断层扫描的原则性置信度估计

sentences.en: We present a principled framework for confidence estimation in computed tomography (CT) reconstruction.
sentences.zh: 我们呈献一个用于计算机断层扫描（CT）重建中置信度估计的原则性框架。

sentences.en: Based on the sequential likelihood mixing framework (Kirschner et al., 2025), we establish confidence regions with theoretical coverage guarantees for deep-learning-based CT reconstructions.
sentences.zh: 基于序贯似然混合框架（Kirschner等人，2025），我们为基于深度学习的CT重建建立具有理论覆盖保证的置信域。

sentences.en: We consider a realistic forward model following the Beer-Lambert law, i.e., a log-linear forward model with Poisson noise, closely reflecting clinical and scientific imaging conditions.
sentences.zh: 我们考虑遵循Beer-Lambert定律的现实前向模型，即带Poisson噪声的对数线性前向模型，紧密反映临床与科学成像条件。

sentences.en: The framework is general and applies to both classical reconstruction algorithms and deep learning methods alike, including U-Nets, U-Net ensembles, and generative Diffusion models.
sentences.zh: 该框架具有通用性，同样适用于经典重建算法与深度学习方法，包括U-Net、U-Net集成与生成式Diffusion模型。

sentences.en: Empirically, we demonstrate that deep reconstruction methods yield substantially tighter confidence regions than classical reconstructions, without sacrificing theoretical coverage guarantees.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，我们证明深度重建方法产生比经典重建显著更紧的置信域，而无需牺牲理论覆盖保证。

sentences.en: Our approach allows the detection of hallucinations in reconstructed images and provides interpretable visualizations of confidence regions.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法允许检测重建图像中的幻觉，并提供置信域的可解释可视化。

sentences.en: This establishes deep models not only as powerful estimators, but also as reliable tools for uncertainty-aware medical imaging.
sentences.zh: 这在将深度模型确立为强大估计器的同时，也确立为不确定性感知医学成像的可靠工具。

title_en: Principled RL for Flow Matching Emerges from the Chunk-level Policy Optimization
title_zh: 从块级策略优化中涌现的用于流程匹配的原则性RL

sentences.en: Recent Progress in post-training flow matching for text-to-image (T2I) generation with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has demonstrated strong potential.
sentences.zh: 近期用组相对策略优化（GRPO）对文生图（T2I）生成的流程匹配进行后训练的进展，展现了强大的潜力。

sentences.en: However, it is hindered by a critical limitation: inaccurate advantage attribution.
sentences.zh: 然而，它受到一个关键局限的阻碍：不准确的优势归因。

sentences.en: In this work, we argue that aggregating consecutive timesteps into a coherent 'chunk' and shifting the policy optimization paradigm from GRPO's step level to the chunk level can effectively mitigate the negative impact of this issue.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们认为将连续时间步聚合为连贯的“块”，并将策略优化范式从GRPO的步级转向块级，可以有效地缓解这一问题的负面影响。

sentences.en: Building on this insight, we propose Group Chunking Policy Optimization (GCPO), the first chunk-level reinforcement learning approach for post-training flow matching.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出组块策略优化（GCPO），第一个用于流程匹配后训练的块级强化学习方法。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that GCPO achieves superior performance on both standard T2I benchmarks and preference alignment, with up to $43$% additional gains over GRPO, highlighting the promise of chunk-level policy optimization.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，GCPO在标准T2I基准与偏好对齐上都取得卓越表现，相较于GRPO有多达$43$%的额外增益，凸显了块级策略优化的前景。

title_en: Principled SVD-based Delta Compression via Quantization Error Minimization
title_zh: 经由量化误差最小化的原则性SVD增量压缩

sentences.en: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) empowers Large Language Models (LLMs) with exceptional performance on specialized tasks, but it yields dense, high-dimensional delta parameters that pose severe storage and distribution challenges.
sentences.zh: 有监督微调（SFT）使大型语言模型（LLM）在专门任务上获得卓越表现，但它产生稠密、高维的增量参数，带来严峻的存储与分发挑战。

sentences.en: Singular Value Decomposition (SVD)-based compression offers a compact representation for such delta parameters, but existing methods adopt heuristic quantization without clarifying underlying mechanisms, leading to poor generalizability.
sentences.zh: 基于奇异值分解（SVD）的压缩为这类增量参数提供了紧凑表示，但现有方法采用启发式量化而未阐明底层机制，导致泛化性差。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose PrinMix, a rigorous SVD-based framework that models quantization as an optimization problem, grounding the design in mathematical mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出PrinMix，一个将量化建模为优化问题的严格SVD框架，将设计扎根于数学机制。

sentences.en: We first theoretically derive quantization error and identify a key singular-value-dominated scaling mechanism, which mathematically proves the necessity of mix-precision quantization.
sentences.zh: 我们首先从理论上推导量化误差，并识别出一个关键的单值主导缩放机制，它从数学上证明了混合精度量化的必要性。

sentences.en: We then model the quantization scheme as a 0/1 Integer Linear Programming (ILP) problem, which yields optimal bit-budget-constrained solutions without empirical assumptions.
sentences.zh: 随后我们将量化方案建模为一个0/1整数线性规划（ILP）问题，它在没有经验假设的情况下产生最优的比特预算约束解。

sentences.en: Furthermore, PrinMix integrates a Reconstruction Target Correction (RTC) method to compensate for errors from the $\mathbf{V}$-then-$\mathbf{U}$ sequential quantization process.
sentences.zh: 此外，PrinMix整合一个重建目标校正（RTC）方法，以补偿 $\mathbf{V}$-然后-$\mathbf{U}$ 序贯量化过程中的误差。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments confirm PrinMix performs well: for 7B LLMs, PrinMix outperforms SOTA Delta-CoMe on challenging benchmarks by 22.3\% on AIME2024 and 6.1\% on GQA.
sentences.zh: 大量实验证实PrinMix表现良好：对于7B LLM，PrinMix在AIME2024与GQA上分别以22.3\%与6.1\%优于最先进的Delta-CoMe。

title_en: Principled Synthetic Data Enables the First Scaling Laws for LLMs in Recommendation
title_zh: 原则性合成数据为推荐中的LLM实现首个扩展定律

sentences.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) represent a promising frontier for recommender systems, yet their development has been impeded by the absence of predictable scaling laws, which are crucial for guiding research and optimizing resource allocation.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）代表推荐系统的一个有前景的前沿，但它们的发展一直受到缺乏可预测扩展定律的阻碍，而扩展定律对于指导研究与优化资源分配至关重要。

sentences.en: We hypothesize that this may be attributed to the inherent noise, bias, and incompleteness of raw user interaction data in prior continual pre-training (CPT) efforts.
sentences.zh: 我们假设这可能归因于先前持续预训练（CPT）工作中原始用户交互数据固有的噪声、偏差与不完整性。

sentences.en: This paper introduces a novel, layered framework for generating high-quality synthetic data that circumvents such issues by creating a curated, pedagogical curriculum for the LLM.
sentences.zh: 本文引入一个新颖的分层框架，用于生成高质量合成数据，通过为LLM创建一个精选的、教学式的课程来规避此类问题。

sentences.en: We provide powerful, direct evidence for the utility of our curriculum by showing that standard sequential models trained on our principled synthetic data significantly outperform ($+130\%$ on recall@100 for SasRec) models trained on real data in downstream ranking tasks, demonstrating its superiority for learning generalizable user preference patterns.
sentences.zh: 我们通过表明在我们原则性合成数据上训练的标准序列模型在下游排序任务中显著优于（在SasRec的recall@100上$+130\%$）在真实数据上训练的模型，为课程效用提供了有力而直接的证据，展示了其在学习可泛化用户偏好模式方面的优越性。

sentences.en: Building on this, we empirically demonstrate, for the first time, robust power-law scaling for an LLM that is continually pre-trained on our high-quality, recommendation-specific data.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，我们首次实证展示了在高质量、推荐特定数据上持续预训练的LLM的稳健幂律扩展行为。

sentences.en: Our experiments reveal consistent and predictable perplexity reduction across multiple synthetic data modalities.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验揭示了跨多种合成数据模态一致且可预测的困惑度降低。

sentences.en: These findings establish a foundational methodology for reliable scaling LLM capabilities in the recommendation domain, thereby shifting the research focus from mitigating data deficiencies to leveraging high-quality, structured information.
sentences.zh: 这些发现为基础方法论的确立奠定了基础，使推荐领域中的LLM能力得以可靠扩展，从而将研究焦点从缓解数据缺陷转向利用高质量、结构化的信息。

title_en: Principled Zero-shot Ranking Agents with Tournament Graphs
title_zh: 带锦标赛图的原则性零样本排序智能体

sentences.en: Large language models have emerged as powerful zero-shot rerankers for retrieval-augmented generation, offering strong generalization without task-specific training.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型已成为检索增强生成的强大零样本重排器，在无需任务特定训练的情况下提供强泛化能力。

sentences.en: However, existing LLM reranking methods either rely on heuristics that fail to fully exploit the information revealed by each ranking decision or are inefficient when they do.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的LLM重排方法要么依赖无法充分利用每次排序决定揭示之信息的启发式，要么在利用时效率低下。

sentences.en: We introduce a *tournament graph* framework that provides a principled foundation for $k$-wise reranking.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个*锦标赛图*框架，为 $k$-路重排提供原则性基础。

sentences.en: Our key observation is that each $k$-document comparison reveals a complete tournament of $\binom{k}{2}$ pairwise preferences.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键观察是，每次 $k$-文档比较揭示一个由 $\binom{k}{2}$ 个成对偏好构成的完整锦标赛。

sentences.en: These tournaments are aggregated into a global preference graph, whose transitive closure yields many additional orderings without further model invocations.
sentences.zh: 这些锦标赛被聚合到一个全局偏好图中，其传递闭包无需进一步调用模型便产生许多额外的排序。

sentences.en: We formalize when a candidate's rank is *certifiably determined* and design a query schedule that greedily maximizes information gain towards identifying the top-$m$ items.
sentences.zh: 我们形式化候选排名何时被*可证明地确定*，并设计一个贪心最大化信息增益以识别顶-$m$项的查询调度。

sentences.en: Our framework also gracefully handles non-transitive preferences -- cycles induced by LLM judgments -- by collapsing them into equivalence classes that yield principled *tiered rankings*.
sentences.zh: 我们的框架还优雅地处理非传递偏好——即由LLM判断诱导的环——通过将它们坍缩为产生原则性*分层排序*的等价类。

sentences.en: Empirically, across 14 benchmarks and 5 LLMs, our approach achieves Pareto dominance over existing methods: matching or exceeding accuracy while requiring 25--40\% fewer tokens than comparable approaches, and 7$\times$ fewer than pairwise methods at near-identical quality.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，跨14个基准与5个LLM，我们的方法实现相对于现有方法的帕累托支配：匹配或超过准确性，同时比同类方法少用25--40\%的词元，且在近乎相同的质量下比成对方法少用7$\times$词元。

topic: General Machine Learning->Online Learning, Active Learning and Bandits
title_en: Prior Diffusiveness and Regret in the Linear-Gaussian Bandit
title_zh: 线性高斯土匪中的先验扩散性与遗憾

sentences.en: We prove that Thompson sampling exhibits $\tilde{O}(\sigma d \sqrt{T} + d r \sqrt{\mathrm{Tr}(\Sigma_0)})$ Bayesian regret in the linear-Gaussian bandit with a $\mathcal{N}(\mu_0, \Sigma_0)$ prior distribution on the coefficients, where $d$ is the dimension, $T$ is the time horizon, $r$ is the maximum $\ell_2$ norm of the actions, and $\sigma^2$ is the noise variance.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在系数带 $\mathcal{N}(\mu_0, \Sigma_0)$ 先验分布的线性高斯土匪中，Thompson采样展现出 $\tilde{O}(\sigma d \sqrt{T} + d r \sqrt{\mathrm{Tr}(\Sigma_0)})$ 的贝叶斯遗憾，其中 $d$ 是维度，$T$ 是时间跨度，$r$ 是动作的最大 $\ell_2$ 范数，$\sigma^2$ 是噪声方差。

sentences.en: In contrast to existing regret bounds, this shows that to within logarithmic factors, the prior-dependent ''burn-in'' term $d r \sqrt{\mathrm{Tr}(\Sigma_0)}$ decouples additively from the minimax (long run) regret \sigma d \sqrt{T}.
sentences.zh: 与现有遗憾界相比，这表明在对数因子以内，依赖于先验的“热身”项 $d r \sqrt{\mathrm{Tr}(\Sigma_0)}$ 与极小极大（长期）遗憾 \sigma d \sqrt{T} 加法地解耦。

sentences.en: Previous regret bounds exhibit a multiplicative dependence on these terms.
sentences.zh: 先前的遗憾界表现出对这些项的乘法依赖。

sentences.en: We establish these results via a new ''elliptical potential'' lemma, and also provide a lower bound indicating that the burn-in term is unavoidable.
sentences.zh: 我们通过一个新的“椭圆势”引理确立这些结果，并提供表明热身项不可避免的下界。

title_en: Prioritize the Process, Not Just the Outcome: Rewarding Latent Thought Trajectories Improves Reasoning in Looped Language Models
title_zh: 优先考虑过程，而非仅为结果：奖励潜在思维轨迹改进循环语言模型的推理

sentences.en: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) perform multi-step latent reasoning prior to token generation and outperform conventional LLMs on reasoning benchmarks at smaller parameter budgets.
sentences.zh: 循环语言模型（LoopLM）在词元生成之前执行多步潜在推理，并在较小的参数预算下在推理基准上优于传统LLM。

sentences.en: However, attempts to further improve LoopLM reasoning with reinforcement learning have failed—standard objectives such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) only assign credit to the final latent state, creating a fundamental mismatch with the model's internal computation.
sentences.zh: 然而，用强化学习进一步改进LoopLM推理的尝试已经失败——像组相对策略优化（GRPO）这样的标准目标只将信用分配给最终的潜在状态，造成与模型内部计算的根本错配。

sentences.en: To resolve this, we introduce RLTT (Reward Latent Thought Trajectories), a reinforcement learning framework which distributes reward across the full latent reasoning trajectory.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一点，我们引入RLTT（奖励潜在思维轨迹），一个将奖励分布在整个潜在推理轨迹上的强化学习框架。

sentences.en: RLTT provides dense, trajectory-level credit assignment without relying on external verifiers and can directly replace GRPO with negligible overhead.
sentences.zh: RLTT提供稠密的轨迹级信用分配，而无需依赖外部验证器，并能在开销可忽略的情况下直接替代GRPO。

sentences.en: Across extensive experiments with Ouro-1.4B/2.6B-Thinking under identical training and inference conditions, RLTT yields statistically significant improvements over GRPO on challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks, improving mean accuracy over MATH-500, AIME24/26, and BeyondAIME by +5.8\% on the 1.4B scale, and  +10.9\% on the 2.6B scale.
sentences.zh: 在Ouro-1.4B/2.6B-Thinking完全相同的训练与推理条件下进行的广泛实验中，RLTT在具有挑战性的数学推理基准上比GRPO取得统计显著的改进，在1.4B规模上使MATH-500、AIME24/26与BeyondAIME的平均准确率提升+5.8\%，在2.6B规模上提升+10.9\%。

sentences.en: Despite being trained exclusively on mathematics, RLTT also transfers effectively to non-mathematical reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of trajectory-level credit assignment for reinforcement learning in LoopLMs.
sentences.zh: 尽管只在数学上训练，RLTT也有效迁移到非数学推理基准，证明了轨迹级信用分配对LoopLM强化学习的有效性。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/jonwill8/RLTT.git.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/jonwill8/RLTT.git 获取。

title_en: Prioritized Model Experience Replay
title_zh: 优先化的模型经验回放

sentences.en: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) improves sample efficiency by leveraging learned dynamics models, but often suffers from unstable training due to dynamics model learning mismatch: models are trained on data from historical policies while being queried under the continually updated current policy.
sentences.zh: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）通过利用习得的动力学模型改进样本效率，但往往因动力学模型学习错配而遭受不稳定训练：模型在来自历史策略的数据上训练，却在不断更新的当前策略下被查询。

sentences.en: This mismatch can cause policy-relevant local model error to remain large even as global prediction error decreases, leading to oscillatory updates.
sentences.zh: 这种错配可能导致即便全局预测误差在下降，策略相关的局部模型误差仍保持较大，从而导致振荡式更新。

sentences.en: We present a finite-horizon performance analysis that decomposes the policy performance gap into global model error, policy-induced distribution shift, and historical policy mixture effects, showing that minimizing global error alone is insufficient for stable optimization.
sentences.zh: 我们呈献一个有限跨度性能分析，将策略性能差距分解为全局模型误差、策略诱导的分布偏移与历史策略混合效应，表明仅最小化全局误差不足以实现稳定优化。

sentences.en: Motivated by this analysis, we propose Prioritized Model Experience Replay (PMER), a lightweight replay mechanism that prioritizes high-error transitions during dynamics model training.
sentences.zh: 受这一分析驱动，我们提出优先化的模型经验回放（PMER），一个在动力学模型训练期间优先考虑高误差转移的轻量级回放机制。

sentences.en: PMER implicitly emphasizes policy-relevant regions without explicit policy distance estimation and integrates seamlessly into Dyna-style MBRL frameworks.
sentences.zh: PMER隐式地强调策略相关区域，而无需显式策略距离估计，并无缝整合进Dyna风格的MBRL框架。

sentences.en: Experiments on MuJoCo benchmarks demonstrate improved stability, faster convergence, and higher sample efficiency.
sentences.zh: 在MuJoCo基准上的实验表明，稳定性改进、收敛更快与样本效率更高。

title_en: Priority-Aware Shapley Value
title_zh: 优先级感知的Shapley值

sentences.en: Shapley values are widely used for model-agnostic data valuation and feature attribution, yet they implicitly assume contributors are interchangeable.
sentences.zh: Shapley值被广泛用于模型无关的数据估值与特征归因，但它们隐式假设贡献者是可互换的。

sentences.en: This can be problematic when contributors are dependent (e.g., reused/augmented data or causal feature orderings) or when contributions should be adjusted by factors such as trust or risk.
sentences.zh: 当贡献者相互依赖（例如复用/增强的数据或因果特征排序）或当贡献应由信任或风险等因素调整时，这可能成为问题。

sentences.en: We propose Priority-Aware Shapley Value (PASV), which incorporates both hard precedence constraints and soft, contributor-specific priority weights.
sentences.zh: 我们提出优先级感知的Shapley值（PASV），它纳入硬性先后约束与软性的、贡献者特定的优先级权重。

sentences.en: PASV is applicable to general precedence structures, recovers precedence-only and weight-only Shapley variants as special cases, and is uniquely characterized by natural axioms.
sentences.zh: PASV适用于一般的优先结构，将仅优先与仅权重的Shapley变体恢复为其特例，并由自然公理唯一刻画。

sentences.en: We develop an efficient adjacent-swap Metropolis–Hastings sampler for scalable Monte Carlo estimation and analyze limiting regimes induced by extreme priority weights.
sentences.zh: 我们开发一个高效的相邻交换Metropolis-Hastings采样器，用于可扩展的Monte Carlo估计，并分析极端优先级权重诱导的极限区制。

sentences.en: Experiments on data valuation (MNIST/CIFAR10) and feature attribution (Census Income) demonstrate more structure-faithful allocations and a practical sensitivity analysis via our proposed ``priority sweeping".
sentences.zh: 在数据估值（MNIST/CIFAR10）与特征归因（Census Income）上的实验，通过我们提出的“优先级扫描”展示了更贴合结构的分配与实用的敏感性分析。

title_en: Prism-MoE: Efficient Dense-to-MoE Conversion for Visual Autoregressive Generation
title_zh: Prism-MoE：面向视觉自回归生成的高效稠密到MoE转换

sentences.en: Scaling up visual autoregressive models improves generation quality but incurs substantial inference costs.
sentences.zh: 扩展视觉自回归模型改进了生成质量，但招致可观的推理成本。

sentences.en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures mitigate this issue through sparse activation and have proven effective in large language models.
sentences.zh: 专家混合（MoE）架构通过稀疏激活缓解这一问题，并已在大型语言模型中被证明有效。

sentences.en: However, training MoE models from scratch remains prohibitively expensive, and dense-to-MoE conversion for visual autoregressive models is still underexplored.
sentences.zh: 然而，从零训练MoE模型仍然昂贵得令人望而却步，而视觉自回归模型的稠密到MoE转换仍未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: To enable *low-cost and high-quality dense-to-MoE conversion*, we propose **Prism-MoE**, an efficient framework for transforming pretrained dense visual autoregressive models into sparse MoE models.
sentences.zh: 为实现*低成本高质量的稠密到MoE转换*，我们提出**Prism-MoE**，一个用于将预训练稠密视觉自回归模型转变为稀疏MoE模型的高效框架。

sentences.en: Prism-MoE consists of two key components.
sentences.zh: Prism-MoE由两个关键组件组成。

sentences.en: First, we introduce trajectory-consistent Initialization, which formulates expert initialization as a principled decomposition problem and preserves the generation trajectory of pretrained models.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们引入轨迹一致的初始化，它将专家初始化表述为一个有原则的分解问题，并保留预训练模型的生成轨迹。

sentences.en: Second, we propose a confidence-adaptive sparse fine-tuning framework that aligns expert specialization with the information density of visual tokens via confidence-aware routing supervision.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们提出置信自适应的稀疏微调框架，通过置信感知的路由监督使专家专门化与视觉词元的信息密度对齐。

sentences.en: Experiments show that Prism-MoE achieves dense-to-MoE conversion with less than **10\%** of the standard training budget, while maintaining generation quality comparable to dense baselines with only **37.5\%** active parameters.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，Prism-MoE以不到标准训练预算**10\%**的成本实现稠密到MoE转换，同时仅用**37.5\%**的激活参数维持与稠密基线相当的生成质量。

title_en: PRISM: Demystifying Retention and Interaction in Mid-Training
title_zh: PRISM：揭开中间训练中的保留与交互

sentences.en: Mid-training is increasingly used to improve the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet its design choices and interaction with evaluation and reinforcement learning (RL) remain poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 中间训练日益被用于改进大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力，但其设计选择以及与评估和强化学习（RL）的交互仍鲜为人知。

sentences.en: Prior work often focuses on narrow domain gains, overlooking retention of general abilities, long-context performance, and RL compatibility.
sentences.zh: 先前工作往往聚焦于狭窄的领域增益，忽视了通用能力的保留、长上下文表现与RL兼容性。

sentences.en: We present $\textbf{PRISM}$ (Demystifying Retention and Interaction in Mid-Training), a holistic empirical study that analyzes mid-training design choices, what to evaluate, and how domain mixtures and training stages interact across model families.
sentences.zh: 我们呈献$\textbf{PRISM}$（揭开中间训练中的保留与交互），一项分析中间训练设计选择、评估什么，以及域混合与训练阶段如何跨模型家族交互的整体性实证研究。

sentences.en: Experiments on Granite-3.3 8B, LLaMA-3.1 8B, and Mistral-7B/24B base models show that a relatively small, high-quality mid-training phase of $\textbf{$\sim$27B}$ tokens acts as a critical stabilizing stage for reasoning.
sentences.zh: 在Granite-3.3 8B、LLaMA-3.1 8B与Mistral-7B/24B基础模型上的实验表明，一个相对较小、高质量的$\textbf{$\sim$27B}$词元中间训练阶段，充当推理的关键稳定阶段。

sentences.en: Across models, PRISM yields consistent gains of $\textbf{$\sim$6–10}$ points on coding benchmarks and $\textbf{$\sim$17–30}$ points on mathematical reasoning benchmarks while preserving general performance.
sentences.zh: 跨模型，PRISM在编码基准上取得一致性的$\textbf{$\sim$6–10}$分增益，在数学推理基准上取得$\textbf{$\sim$17–30}$分增益，同时保持通用表现。

sentences.en: RL applied on top of PRISM-mid-trained models produces stable, monotonic improvements, adding a further $\textbf{$\sim$3–8}$ points across coding and math tasks such as LiveCodeBench, Codeforces, AIME and MATH500, and $\textbf{$\sim$17–20}$ points on science (GPQA-Diamond), whereas RL applied directly to base models is substantially less effective.
sentences.zh: 在PRISM中间训练模型之上应用RL产生稳定、单调的改进，在LiveCodeBench、Codeforces、AIME与MATH500等编码与数学任务上再添$\textbf{$\sim$3–8}$分，在科学（GPQA-Diamond）上添$\textbf{$\sim$17–20}$分，而直接应用于基础模型的RL效果显著较差。

sentences.en: Our results demonstrate that retention-aware mid-training is a necessary intermediate step for reliable reasoning enhancement and RL scaling, and provide practical guidance for designing robust mid-training pipelines for modern LLMs.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，保留感知的中间训练是可靠推理增强与RL扩展的必要中间步骤，并为设计现代LLM的稳健中间训练流程提供实用指导。

title_en: PRISM: Distribution-free Adaptive Computation of Matrix Functions for Accelerating Neural Network Training
title_zh: PRISM：用于加速神经网络训练的矩阵函数无分布自适应计算

sentences.en: Matrix functions such as square root, inverse roots, and orthogonalization play a central role in preconditioned gradient methods for neural network training.
sentences.zh: 平方根、逆根与正交化等矩阵函数在神经网络训练的预条件梯度方法中起核心作用。

sentences.en: This has motivated the development of iterative algorithms that avoid explicit eigendecompositions and rely primarily on matrix multiplications, making them well suited for modern GPU accelerators.
sentences.zh: 这推动了迭代算法的发展，这些算法避免显式的特征分解，主要依赖矩阵乘法，使其非常适合现代GPU加速器。

sentences.en: We present PRISM (Polynomial-fitting and Randomized Iterative Sketching for Matrix functions computation), a general framework for accelerating iterative algorithms for computing matrix functions.
sentences.zh: 我们呈献PRISM（用于矩阵函数计算的Polynomial-fitting and Randomized Iterative Sketching，即多项式拟合与随机迭代素描），一个用于加速计算矩阵函数迭代算法的通用框架。

sentences.en: PRISM combines adaptive polynomial approximation with randomized sketching: at each iteration, it fits a polynomial surrogate to the current spectrum via a sketched least-squares problem, adapting to the instance at hand with minimal overhead.
sentences.zh: PRISM将自适应多项式近似与随机素描相结合：在每次迭代中，它通过一个素描最小二乘问题为当前谱拟合一个多项式替代物，以最小开销适应手头的实例。

sentences.en: We apply PRISM to accelerate Newton–Schulz-like iterations for matrix square roots and orthogonalization, which are core primitives in machine learning.
sentences.zh: 我们将PRISM应用于加速Newton-Schulz类迭代，用于机器学习核心原语的矩阵平方根与正交化。

sentences.en: Unlike prior methods, PRISM requires no explicit spectral bounds or singular value estimates; it adapts automatically to the evolving spectrum.
sentences.zh: 与先前方法不同，PRISM不需要显式的谱界或奇异值估计；它自动适应演化的谱。

sentences.en: Empirically, PRISM accelerates training when integrated into Shampoo and Muon optimizers.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，当整合进Shampoo与Muon优化器时，PRISM加速训练。

title_en: PRISM: Gauge-Invariant Tangent-Space Differentially Private LoRA
title_zh: PRISM：规范不变的切空间差分私有LoRA

sentences.en: Applying differential privacy (DP) via DP-SGD to Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a natural approach for privacy-preserving fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 通过DP-SGD将差分隐私（DP）应用于低秩适配（LoRA）是隐私保护微调的自然方法。

sentences.en: However, applying DP-SGD to LoRA poses a fundamental challenge due to its low-rank parameterization.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于LoRA的低秩参数化，将DP-SGD应用于LoRA构成一个根本挑战。

sentences.en: In LoRA, each trainable update is represented as a low-rank matrix $Z=AB^\top$, but this factorization is non-identifiable.
sentences.zh: 在LoRA中，每个可训练更新被表示为低秩矩阵 $Z=AB^\top$，但这种分解是不可辨认的。

sentences.en: As a result, applying DP-SGD directly to factors $(A,B)$ induces gauge-dependent perturbations on $Z$, leading to uncontrolled noise amplification.
sentences.zh: 其结果，将DP-SGD直接应用于因子（$(A,B)$）会在 $Z$ 上诱发规范依赖的扰动，导致不受控的噪声放大。

sentences.en: We propose **PRISM**, an intrinsic DP mechanism for LoRA that is gauge invariant by construction, avoids bilinear noise amplification, and admits an efficient low-dimensional noise sampler.
sentences.zh: 我们提出**PRISM**，一个LoRA的内在DP机制，它按构造规范不变，避免双线性噪声放大，并且容许高效的低维噪声采样器。

sentences.en: Moreover, PRISM yields a closed-form characterization for the effective intrinsic noise on $Z$, and enables stable privacy–utility trade-offs by being gauge invariant and keeping noise amplification bounded.
sentences.zh: 此外，PRISM为 $Z$ 上的有效内在噪声产生闭式刻画，并通过保持规范不变与使噪声放大有界，实现稳定的隐私-效用权衡。

sentences.en: We further characterize the noise amplification incurred by naive DP-LoRA and show that it can be unbounded, establish standard $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-DP guarantees for PRISM, and introduce a DP-aware, gauge-invariant adaptive update that avoids amplifying injected privacy noise under adaptive optimization, improving numerical stability in practice.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步刻画朴素DP-LoRA所致的噪声放大并表明它可能是无界的，为PRISM建立标准的（$(\varepsilon,\delta)$）-DP保证，并引入一个DP感知、规范不变的自适应更新，避免在自适应优化下放大注入的隐私噪声，在实践中改善数值稳定性。

title_en: PRISM: Learning Realistic Depth via Physics-Grounded Noise Disentanglement with Semantic-Geometric Collaboration
title_zh: PRISM：通过物理根植的噪声解缠与语义-几何协作学习真实深度

sentences.en: Real-world physical sensing exhibits complex, heterogeneous noise patterns that deviate significantly from idealized simulation, posing a fundamental bottleneck for sim-to-real transfer.
sentences.zh: 真实世界的物理传感展现出复杂、异质的噪声模式，与理想化仿真显著不同，构成sim-to-real转移的根本瓶颈。

sentences.en: Existing sensor modelings typically treat depth noise as a monolithic black-box process, overlooking the distinct physical mechanisms that govern different error modalities.
sentences.zh: 现有的传感器建模通常将深度噪声视为整体式的黑箱过程，忽视了支配不同误差模态的独特物理机制。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce a physics-grounded paradigm that disentangles monolithic noise into two complementary modalities: sensing invalidation and measurement inaccuracy, enabling a tailored treatment of noise sources based on their physical origins.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入一个物理根植的范式，将整体式噪声解缠为两个互补模态：传感失效与测量不精确，从而能够基于其物理起源对噪声源进行量身定制的处理。

sentences.en: Building on this insight, we propose PRISM, a tripartite framework that distills 3D Visual Foundation Model features as rich spatial-semantic priors for physics-based reasoning.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出PRISM，一个三元框架，将3D视觉基础模型特征蒸馏为用于基于物理推理的丰富空间-语义先验。

sentences.en: To address the inherent sparsity and class imbalance of invalidation regions, we develop Hierarchical Positive-Prioritized Supervision, integrating multi-scale positive-weighted objectives with a positive-preserving dynamic hard mining strategy to enforce precise artifact delineation.
sentences.zh: 为应对失效区域固有的稀疏性与类别不平衡，我们开发层次化正优先监督，整合多尺度正加权目标与正保留的动态难例挖掘策略，以强制执行精确的伪影勾画。

sentences.en: Extensive benchmarks demonstrate that PRISM achieves state-of-the-art fidelity in noisy depth synthesis.
sentences.zh: 大量基准表明，PRISM在含噪声深度合成中达到最先进的保真度。

sentences.en: Furthermore, downstream robotic experiments show that PRISM facilitates a 92.1% average success rate in the real world, marking a significant improvement over monolithic baselines.
sentences.zh: 此外，下游机器人实验表明，PRISM在真实世界中促成92.1%的平均成功率，相较于整体式基线标志着显著改进。
